subject: general
question: What does the Prasad Scheme of the Central Government focus on?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Development of pilgrimage destinations**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Development of pilgrimage destinations** is the primary focus of the Prasad Scheme of the Central Government.
 
• The scheme aims to enhance tourist attractiveness by developing world-class infrastructure in pilgrimage centers.
 
• It includes various initiatives like improvement of amenities, better connectivity, and overall development of the destinations to boost tourism.
 
• The full form of PRASAD is **Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Augmentation Drive**.
 
• The scheme was launched in the year **2014-15** by the Ministry of Tourism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Prasad Scheme covers various pilgrimage sites across India, including famous temples, mosques, and churches.
 
• It is part of the larger initiative to promote cultural and heritage tourism in India.
 
• The scheme is implemented in collaboration with the respective state governments, ensuring local development and community participation.
 
• Enhancing the infrastructure and overall experience at these sites aims to attract both domestic and international tourists, boosting the local economy.
